why.Case.Origin: An email-origin Case starts production's Case_Classify_On_Email_Create Flow, which queues an Apex job; a pending job blocks redeploying its classes (#289). Generated data never picks these values; a scenario that sets one explicitly still can.
why.profileExclude: Fields whose production average must not be read when a request loads ("Opportunity.Amount"): their values are then spread evenly.
